Woody Hill Monday Night Ride (RINEMBA)

Westerly, RI · Mountain bike

Woody Hill Monday Night Ride (RINEMBA) is a mountain bike group ride in Westerly, RI. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Westerly Youth Lacrosse Fields.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: intermediate. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Woody Hill Monday Night Ride (RINEMBA) group ride

A weekly night mountain bike ride at Woody Hill at an intermediate pace. NEMBA says a second group may form if needed.
